DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ルーペを借りた方ですね。見え方はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kayo po ang humiram ng magnifying glass? Kumusta ang tanaw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ぼやけます。花の近くへ顔を寄せても、はっきり見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りたルーペがぼやけると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Malabo. Kahit ilapit ang mukha sa bulaklak, hindi malinaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang malabong hiniram na magnifying glass. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ルーペを目に近づけ、見る物との距離を変えてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ilapit sa mata ang magnifying glass at baguhin ang layo sa tinitingnan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 目の前で固定して、花から少し離すのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目とルーペを固定し花との距離を変える方法を聞き直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hahawakan sa harap ng mata at ilalayo nang kaunti sa bulaklak, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ulitin ang paghawak nang nakapirmi sa mata at pagbabago ng layo sa bulaklak. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。今見えた所で止めてください。花は摘まず、咲いたままで見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Huminto sa puntong nakita ngayon. Hindi kailangang pitasin, puwedeng tingnan habang namumulaklak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 模様が見えました。この葉の細かい毛も見ていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花の模様が見え葉の毛も見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nakita ang disenyo. Maaari ring tingnan ang maliliit na balahibo sa dahong ito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing nakita ang disenyo ng bulaklak at nais makita ang balahibo ng dahon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。この低い枝なら、枝を引かずにのぞけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige. Sa mababang sangang ito, masisilip nang hindi hinihila.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここから見えます。花の模様と葉の毛を、ノートに描きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 枝を引かず観察しノートに描くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kita mula rito. Iguguhit ko ang disenyo ng bulaklak at balahibo ng dahon sa kuwaderno.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magmasid nang hindi hinihila ang sanga at sabihing iguguhit sa kuwaderno. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 描き終わったら、ルーペは受付の箱へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatapos gumuhit, ibalik ang magnifying glass sa kahon sa reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つ描けました。首のひもをまとめて、ルーペを箱へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 描き終えひもをまとめてルーペを返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiguhit ang dalawa. Aayusin ko ang tali sa leeg at ibabalik sa kahon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tapusin ang guhit, ayusin ang tali, at ibalik ang magnifying glass. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お返しいただきました。またお越しください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅からのバスについてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa bus mula sa istasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。案内に「休日は南口」とあります。今日は祝日ですが、南口へ行けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祝日の休日用南口乗り場を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Sabi sa gabay, south exit kapag holiday. Public holiday ngayon, south exit ang pupuntahan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang sakayan sa south exit para sa holiday ngayong public holiday. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、今日は南口です。平日の北口とは停留所が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Oo, south exit ngayon. Iba sa weekday stop sa north exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 山の交流館へ行く便も、南口からですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交流館行きの乗り場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pati bus sa community center sa bundok ay mula south exit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang sakayan sa community center. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その便は南口の二番乗り場です。出発まであと十二分あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Stop two sa south exit ang bus na iyon. Labindalawang minuto bago umalis.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今から向かいます。改札を出て左が南口ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 南口への方向を確かめ移動する意思を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pupunta na ako. Kaliwa paglabas ng ticket gate ang south exit, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang direksiyon sa south exit at sabihing pupunta. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。階段の下に二番乗り場の案内があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. May gabay ng stop two sa ibaba ng hagdan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 着いたら停留所の時刻表も見ます。バスの行先表示は交流館ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停留所時刻表とバス行先表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Titingnan ko rin ang timetable pagdating. Community center ba ang destination display ng bus?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang timetable sa hintuan at destination display ng bus. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終点の「東谷」と出ます。交流館は途中で止まる停留所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: “東谷,” ang dulong destinasyon, ang nakalagay. Intermediate stop ang community center.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東谷行きに乗り、交流館で降ります。休日の乗り場も分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 東谷行き乗車と途中交流館下車をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sasakay sa 東谷 at bababa sa community center. Alam ko na rin ang holiday stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibuod ang pagsakay sa 東谷-bound at pagbaba sa community center sa gitna. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、お気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 防災用品の展示をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tinitingnan po ang exhibit ng disaster supplies?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家で持出し袋を作りましたが、重くて長く背負えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持出し袋が重く背負えないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Gumawa ako ng go-bag sa bahay pero mabigat, hindi kayang pasanin nang matagal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang mabigat na go-bag na mahirap pasanin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どんな物を入れましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水のほか、鍋と大きな毛布を入れました。持って歩く用に考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 水鍋毛布を持ち歩く想定で入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bukod sa tubig, kaldero at malaking kumot. Para sana sa pagdadala habang naglalakad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang tubig, kaldero at kumot para dalhin sa paglalakad. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この展示では、家に置く備蓄と、すぐ持ち出す物を分けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa exhibit, hiwalay ang imbak sa bahay at agad dadalhin palabas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: なるほど。鍋と毛布は家の備蓄へ戻し、持出し袋には薄い防寒用の物を入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍋毛布を備蓄に戻し軽い防寒品へ変更すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ganoon pala. Ibabalik ko ang kaldero at kumot sa imbak at manipis na panlaban sa lamig ang ilalagay sa go-bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang ibalik ang kaldero at kumot sa imbak at palitan ng magaan na panlamig. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示の小さいリュックなら、重さを体験できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Masusubukan ang bigat ng maliit na backpack sa exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 背負ってみます。これくらいなら、両手を空けて歩けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示リュックを試し両手を空けて歩けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Susubukan ko. Sa bigat na ito, makalalakad akong malaya ang dalawang kamay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Subukan ang exhibit backpack at sabihing makalalakad na malaya ang kamay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 展示品の内容表もあります。必要な薬などは、ご自分の状況に合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: May listahan din ng laman. Iangkop ang kailangang gamot at iba pa sa sariling kalagayan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表を持ち帰り、家の袋を量り直します。薬のことは、いつもの薬局でも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容表で袋を見直し薬は薬局へ相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Iuuwi ko ang listahan at titimbangin muli ang bag. Ikokonsulta ko rin ang gamot sa regular kong botika.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang suriin ang bag gamit ang listahan at itanong ang gamot sa botika. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお持ちください。ご覧いただきありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 顔色がすぐれませんが、具合はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Maputla po kayo. Ano ang pakiramdam?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっきから気持ちが悪いです。採血の順番を待っていますが、座っているのもつらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採血待ち中の吐き気と座位のつらさを知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kanina pa ako nasusuka. Naghihintay ng blood draw pero mahirap kahit umupo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang pagsusuka sa pakiramdam at hirap umupo habang naghihintay sa blood draw. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、吐きそうですか。こちらで体を支えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Parang susuka ngayon? Aalalayan kita rito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、少し。袋をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 吐きそうな状態を伝え袋を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, kaunti. Maaari bang makahingi ng bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing parang susuka at humingi ng bag. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらをお使いください。いつから気持ちが悪くなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Gamitin ito. Kailan nagsimula ang pagduduwal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五分くらい前です。来た時は平気で、朝から何も食べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五分前発症と来院時正常及び朝食なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mga limang minuto na. Ayos ako pagdating, at wala pang kinakain mula umaga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang simula limang minuto na, maayos pagdating at walang almusal. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 検査の予定を確認して、担当へ知らせます。別の場所で休めるようにしますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Susuriin ang nakaiskedyul na test at ipaaalam sa nakatalaga. Aayusin ang ibang pahingahan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。受付の番号が呼ばれたら、まだ来ていないと思われないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休む場所へ移る際の呼出し番号の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sige po. Kapag tinawag ang numero ko, hindi ba iisiping hindi pa ako dumating?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang call number kapag lilipat sa pahingahan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらから、ここにいらっしゃることも連絡します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。番号は三十二番です。具合が変わったらすぐお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三十二番を伝え症状変化を知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Thirty-two ang numero. Magsasabi agad kapag nagbago ang pakiramdam.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang numero32 at pagsasabi ng pagbabago ng sintomas. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号も伝えました。そばで様子を見ますね。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naipasa na ang numero. Mananatili sa tabi upang magmasid. Paumanhin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 門が壊れていたというお話ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nasira po ang gate ninyo, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。仕事から帰ると、門の右側が曲がっていました。道路に車の破片のような物もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅時の門の変形と道路の破片を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Pag-uwi mula trabaho, baluktot ang kanan ng gate. May parang piraso ng kotse rin sa kalsada.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang baluktot na gate sa pag-uwi at piraso sa kalsada. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今もその場所にありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。踏まれないように、門の内側から写真を撮っただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現物を動かさず内側から写真撮影したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo. Kinuhaan ko lang mula loob ng gate para hindi matapakan ang mga iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi ginalaw at kinunan mula loob. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に門が無事だったのは、いつでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝八時に出た時です。帰ったのは夕方六時でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正常の朝八時と発見の夕六時を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nang umalis nang alas-otso ngayong umaga. Alas-sais ng gabi ako umuwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang maayos na alas-otso at pagkakita alas-sais. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車との接触を見た方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: May nakakita ng pagbangga ng kotse?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 隣の方が昼ごろ音を聞いたそうです。車を見たかは、まだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 隣人が音を聞いた情報と車目撃未確認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Narinig daw ng kapitbahay ang tunog bandang tanghali. Hindi ko pa natanong kung nakakita ng kotse.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang narinig ng kapitbahay sa hindi tiyak na pagkakita ng kotse. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのお話も含め、担当が現場の状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kasama ang kuwentong iyan, susuriin ng nakatalaga ang lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。曲がった門は開けにくいので、無理に直さず、家の別の入口を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 門を無理に直さず別入口を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige. Mahirap buksan ang baluktot na gate kaya hindi ko pipiliting ayusin; ibang pasukan ng bahay ang gagamitin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pipiliting ayusin ang gate at gagamit ng ibang pasukan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご相談ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた封筒についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa dumating na sobre?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の家のポストに入っていましたが、知らない人の名前が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅ポストへ届いた別人宛て封筒を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Nasa mailbox ko pero pangalan ng hindi ko kilala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang sobreng para sa iba sa sariling mailbox. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地は同じですが、部屋番号が一〇三です。私は二〇三に住んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同番地の一〇三と自室二〇三の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Parehong numero ng kalye pero kuwarto103. Sa203 ako nakatira.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang103 at sariling203 sa parehong address. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒は未開封ですね。こちらでお預かりできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hindi pa bukas, tama? Maaari naming tanggapin dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、開けていません。一〇三の方に渡そうと思いましたが、留守だったので持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封と宛先部屋不在のため持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo, hindi binuksan. Ibibigay sana sa103 pero wala sila kaya dinala ko rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi bukas at dinala dahil wala sa bahay ang tatanggap. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お届け先を確認して、配達担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ang address at ibibigay sa delivery staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。私の郵便物も一緒に入っていたので、この一通だけお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分宛てと混ざった一通のみを渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sige. Kasama rin ang sarili kong sulat kaya itong isa lang ang ibibigay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ibigay lang ang isang liham na nahalo sa sariling mail. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの一通をお預かりしました。ほかの郵便物はお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tinanggap itong isa. Ibabalik ang ibang sulat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分宛ての二通は受け取りました。別の方の封筒をお願いできて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分宛て二通の受取を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natanggap ko ang sarili kong dalawa. Mabuti at naiwan ko sa inyo ang sobre ng iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pagtanggap ng dalawang sariling liham. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳の記載についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa nakasulat sa passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。引っ越しの手続きをしましたが、通帳の住所は前のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所変更後も通帳が旧住所のままと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Naasikaso ang paglipat pero luma pa ang address sa passbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang lumang address sa passbook pagkatapos ng pagpapalit. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 登録が変わったか確認します。お手続きはいつされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Susuriin ang rehistro. Kailan ginawa ang proseso?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月の十日です。その時の受付控えも持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手続き日と受付控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Noong ikasampu ng nakaraang buwan. Dala ko rin ang katibayan noon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang petsa at ipakita ang katibayan ng pagtanggap. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認したところ、登録は新住所になっています。通帳の印字は変更前のものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Natiyak na bagong address ang rehistro. Luma ang nakalimbag sa passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。この古い印字は、新しく書き換えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録済みを理解し印字の更新を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naintindihan ko. Mapapalitan ang lumang limbag na ito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Unawaing rehistrado na at itanong ang pagpapalit ng limbag. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通帳の記載を更新できるか、窓口で確認します。今日お持ちの通帳が対象ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa counter susuriin kung mapapalitan. Ang passbook na dala ngayon, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家で見た時に迷うので、更新できればお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手元通帳の更新希望と家で混乱する理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Nalilito ako kapag tinitingnan sa bahay, kaya sana mapalitan kung puwede.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging palitan ang passbook at ipaliwanag ang pagkalito sa bahay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この通帳は印字を更新できます。こちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Mapapalitan ang limbag nitong passbook. Tatanggapin namin dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。返していただいたら、新住所の番地を見て確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 更新依頼後に新住所番地を照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige. Kapag naibalik, titiyakin ko ang numero sa bagong address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipagawa ang update at sabihing susuriin ang bagong address number. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 更新した通帳をお返しします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Narito ang na-update na passbook. Salamat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお寿司を受け取りにいらした方ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、井上です。四時の予約ですが、食べるのは六時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約寿司を六時に食べる予定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, Inoue. Alas-kuwatro ang reserba pero alas-sais kakainin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing alas-sais kakainin ang nireserbang sushi. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取りまでこちらで保冷できます。お帰りまで、どのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Mapananatiling malamig dito hanggang pickup. Gaano katagal pauwi?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩いて十分です。まだほかの買物があるので、先に済ませてから受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 徒歩十分と他の買物後に受け取りたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sampung minutong lakad. May iba pang bibilhin kaya gusto kong tapusin muna bago kunin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang sampung minutong lakad at pagkuha matapos ibang pamimili. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、最後にこのカウンターへお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa huli bumalik sa counter na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。予約の三パックは、この大きさですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約の三パックのサイズを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ganoon gagawin ko. Ganito ang laki ng tatlong pack na reserba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang laki ng tatlong reserbang pack. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、三パックでご用意しています。お持ちの袋へは平らに入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo, tatlong pack. Magkakasya nang patag sa bag ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 底の広い保冷バッグを持ってきました。重ねず入れられそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 底広の保冷バッグへ平らに入れる準備を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dala ko ang cooler bag na malapad ang ilalim. Mukhang magkakasya nang hindi nakasalansan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang malapad na cooler bag para sa patag na paglalagay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、受取り時にお包みします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に日用品を買ってから戻ります。帰ったら冷蔵し、表示の期限も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日用品購入後に戻り帰宅後冷蔵と表示確認をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Bibili muna ng pang-araw-araw na gamit at babalik. Pag-uwi, ilalagay sa refrigerator at titingnan ang expiry sa label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing babalik matapos bumili ng gamit, palalamigin at susuriin ang label sa bahay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お戻りをお待ちしています。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 芝生のロープについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa lubid ng damuhan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもとボールで遊ぶつもりでしたが、今日は入れないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ロープのある芝生でボール遊びができるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Balak kong maglaro ng bola kasama ang anak. Bawal pumasok ngayon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang paglalaro sa damuhang may lubid. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 雨で地面が傷みやすくなっているので、今日は閉めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Dahil sa ulan, madaling masira ang lupa kaya sarado ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 投げる遊びができる別の場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の投げ遊び場所を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: May ibang lugar na puwedeng maghagisan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Maghanap ng ibang lugar ng hagisan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 遊具の奥の砂地は使えます。硬いボールではなく、柔らかい物をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Puwede ang buhanginan sa likod ng kagamitan sa palaruan. Malambot na bola, hindi matigas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このスポンジのボールです。二人で近くから投げ合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 柔らかいスポンジ球と近距離の遊び方を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Itong sponge ball. Dalawa kaming maghahagisan mula sa malapit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang malambot na sponge ball at maikling distansiya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでしたら、通路から離れた中央側で遊んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Doon sa gitnang bahagi, malayo sa daanan, maglaro.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路へ飛ばない向きに立ちます。砂地へは右の道で行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路へ飛ばない向きと砂地経路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Haharap kami para hindi mapunta sa daanan. Daan sa kanan papunta sa buhanginan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang direksiyong hindi sa daanan at ruta sa buhanginan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、右の道です。水たまりをよけてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo, kanan. Iwasan ang mga lusak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は砂地で遊び、芝生は乾いた日にまた来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は砂地を選び芝生利用を後日へ変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naintindihan ko. Sa buhangin muna ngayon at babalik sa damuhan sa tuyong araw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliin ang buhangin ngayon at ibang araw ang damuhan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、楽しくお過ごしください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車券がぬれてしまったのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。傘を畳む時に落としました。改札機に入れていいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨でぬれた券を改札機に入れられるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Nahulog habang tinutupi ang payong. Hindi alam kung puwedeng ipasok sa ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang pagpasok ng basang tiket sa makina. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで拝見します。券の行先と日付は読めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan ko. Nababasa ang destinasyon at petsa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の東町行きです。切符を新しく買う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の行先を伝え買い直しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Para sa 東町 ngayon. Kailangang bumili ulit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang destinasyon ngayon at itanong ang pagbili muli. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の状態を確認できましたので、この有人通路からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Natiyak ang kondisyon, dadaan kayo sa passage na may kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。帰りの切符は別の袋に入れてあり、ぬれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰り券は別袋で無事と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Salamat. Hiwalay na supot ang tiket pauwi at hindi nabasa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na ligtas ang tiket pauwi sa ibang supot. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、ぬれた券はこちらで確認の処理をします。お持ち帰りの際は別にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipaproseso ang pagtiyak sa basang tiket. Ihiwalay habang dala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この小さい袋に一枚だけ入れます。列車に乗ってから提示を求められたら、そのまま見せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ぬれた券を分け車内提示時の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Isang tiket lang sa maliit na supot na ito. Kapag hinanap sa tren, ipapakita nang ganito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang basang tiket at itanong ang pagpapakita sa tren. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。まず券をお見せになって、ぬれた経緯もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Ipakita muna at ipaliwanag kung paano nabasa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。東町行きの券を受け取り、有人通路から入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済み券を受け取り有人通路へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naintindihan. Tatanggapin ang tiket sa 東町 at papasok sa passage na may kawani.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tanggapin ang natiyak na tiket at pumunta sa staffed passage. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらへどうぞ。いってらっしゃい。
